checks.invariant: GET /integrations/facebook/status and GET /facebook/posts must not return unsealed Page or user access tokens
checks.result: facebook_status maps connection_status through FacebookStatusOut (configured, connected, needs_reconnect, page_id, page_name, user_id as Meta facebook_user_id, connected_at, token_error, graph_api_version, oauth_scopes, calendar_auto_approve). connection_status unseals facebook_page_token_enc only to compute the connected boolean and does not put the secret on the dict. facebook_list_posts maps FacebookPagePost rows through FacebookPagePostOut (ids, caption, status, Graph facebook_post_id, error_message, schedule timestamps). Neither schema has a token field. token_error and post error_message are MetaGraphError.message (Graph error copy, optionally with a reconnect suffix), not the access token. listed_pages is a separate owner-gated route and strips Graph access_token before FacebookPageChoiceOut.

checks.invariant: Catalogger read of same-tenant Page name and post captions must not exceed the owner-only Facebook connect/preview/publish model
checks.result: require_facebook_poster is owner-only and its docstring limits that gate to connect, pick a Page, and post. GET status and GET /facebook/posts use get_current_user only. Mutations (oauth/start, pages list/select, disconnect, settings, preview, POST /facebook/posts, batches, calendar Approve/cancel) call require_facebook_poster or is_owner. test_preview_and_publish_are_owner_only asserts catalogger 403 on preview and POST, not on the GETs. roles.py treats cataloggers as staff who share sale inventory; captions are lot listing copy they already read and edit. Account UI copy is 'Owners only to connect' and still renders page_name plus recent caption slices to cataloggers; dashboard/lots/engagement fetch status only for the configured boolean and hide Post-to-Page behind isOwnerRole. Catalogger visibility of page name/captions is intended same-tenant staff share, not a crossing of the owner-only write model.

checks.invariant: Unauthenticated callers, client logins, and other tenants cannot read Facebook status or post history
checks.result: Both GETs depend on get_current_user (Bearer). enforce_client_http runs before the handlers; facebook paths are absent from client_http_allowed, so clients receive 403. facebook_status loads Account by current.account_id. list_posts filters FacebookPagePost.account_id == current.account_id and optionally lot_id; a foreign lot_id still cannot return another tenant's rows. No Host or query token is used as tenant selector.

hardening: If product wants owner-only Facebook identity reads, gate GET /facebook/posts and non-boolean FacebookStatusOut fields with require_facebook_poster; dashboard, lot detail, and engagement only consume configured.
Keep FacebookStatusOut and FacebookPagePostOut free of unsealed Page/user tokens; connection_status should keep unsealing only for the connected boolean.

Optionally omit page_id, facebook_user_id, token_error, oauth_scopes, calendar_auto_approve, and Graph facebook_post_id from catalogger responses; those are integration telemetry beyond page name and listing captions.
Account already treats connect, disconnect, and calendar_auto_approve as owner-only while showing page name and recent captions to cataloggers; that matches same-tenant staff share of catalog copy.
